LanguageData.Raven_Item_CorruptionTalisman.label: [Raven] Mind Corruption Talisman
LanguageData.Raven_Item_CorruptionTalisman.descriptio: A talisman drawn with cinnabar runes that gives off a unique scent. It's said that placing it on a target's forehead can influence their will. While carrying this talisman, a [Attach Talisman] command will appear on the carrier.
